tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Call this tool FIRST to retrieve the fully structured documentation header as JSON. Returns hierarchical sections with parsed content (no raw markdown). Includes installation instructions, critical notices, and subsections with their content and code blocks. This provides essential context before exploring specific components.

tools.name: get_list_components
tools.description: List all Taiga UI documentation section IDs (structured JSON only).

tools.name: get_component_example
tools.description: Return section-related content snippets (formerly examples) for specified documentation section name(s). The presence of id indicates a successful match.

tools.name: get_migration_guide
tools.description: Returns the complete Migration Guide for Taiga UI updates. Includes step-by-step migration instructions, troubleshooting, and common issues. Call this tool when you need to migrate between Taiga UI versions.
